summary: After a failed group, the FSM ignores the first bit of the next group.
reasoning: State sf6 represents completion of a failed six-bit group. Its unconditional transition to s1 treats the next sampled bit as a matching 0, even when data is 1. This conflicts with checking non-overlapping groups beginning at the seventh bit. The withheld regression failure is consistent with this fault, but does not identify its exact test case.
